assumptions.meaning: Sound verification, a finite trusted roster, bounded faulty signers, a sufficient threshold and honest source checks remain inherited locale premises.

One actual source history supplies one immutable non-Observed outcome per key. Alternative finalization and reversal histories do not share a universal stable map. Physical source control and cryptography require refinement.

The model stores one immutable full-binding terminal core. Distributed agreement, epoch transition and restart realization of this authority are not supplied by a local update or a source-fact threshold.

Actual routing must preserve immutable identity, persistent effect deduplication and no-effect fences, authenticated current outcomes, one-time returns and the relation between physical holdings and modeled allocation.

The authority owns actual current context and dependencies. Current reads compare the complete logical snapshot; protected use checks current authorization. This extensional equality is not a constant-cost or code-generated network implementation.

One authority callback and its durable result/log insertion form one model step. Invocation identity, retained completed failures and persistence across physical crashes require implementation evidence.
Recovery validates an exact candidate against an authentic complete current authority genesis and journal. Internal replayability alone does not supply authenticity, completeness or freshness.

Core product words and separately defined response relations have their stated scope. The richer physical projection is not a full transition simulation or a classifier of every API reply. Public raw observers remain separately visible.

Finite call completion can return a failure. Successful cached reads need readiness and a quiescent refresh-to-use interval. Terminal progress requires the stated evidence, authorization and action-delivery conditions; no unconditional termination is asserted.

Machine ranges, ABI, encoding, hash preimages, real routes, compiled consumers and physical primary/secondary settlement require separate evidence. All unimplemented tests and unverified consumers retain that status.
